source_title: Credential Redaction for Composio-Managed Auth Configs and Connections
claim_summary: Changelog says connections on Composio-managed auth configs always redact access/refresh tokens and Authorization header in API responses; auth-config GETs redact or mask credential fields; tool execution unchanged server-side
availability: vendor-stated rollout; no plan limits stated
limitation: Vendor statement only; Composio still holds and uses unredacted tokens server-side; no independent test

source_title: SDK file upload hardening: sensitive path blocking and upload hooks
claim_summary: SDKs block automatic uploads from credential paths (e.g. .ssh .aws .env) by default with extra denylist segments and a before-upload hook; applies from @composio/core 0.6.11 and Python composio 0.11.6
availability: released SDK versions named
limitation: Denylist is defence-in-depth not a sandbox; a CLI code path lacked this check until July (see CI2026-047-014)

source_title: SDKs remove legacy automatic file handling config; Link Auth Migration; Proxy execute same-domain enforcement
claim_summary: Proxy execute rejects endpoints outside the connection's registrable domain (400 OriginMismatch); auto file upload stays off unless dangerously* flag set (core 0.8.0 / py 0.12.0); Composio-managed OAuth initiate() moves to link() with cutovers 2026-05-08 (new orgs) and 2026-07-03 (all orgs)
feature: credential forwarding scope; auth flow migration
availability: breaking changes shipped; July 3 cutover was a scheduled future date at publication
limitation: Whether the July 3 cutover happened as scheduled was not independently verified; migration cost to integrators unmeasured

source_title: Webhook Triggers V2
claim_summary: Opt-in V2 webhook endpoints per OAuth app with ingress-level signature verification, per-user authorization for private channels/DMs and config-level event filters; V1 unchanged
availability: opt-in; scoped to new trigger slugs
limitation: Opt-in only; legacy V1 path remains; no independent verification of signature checks

source_title: Incident Report: April 28th
claim_summary: Vendor reports ~53 min cumulative core API degradation and ~36 h webhook trigger outage for ~700 customers Apr 28-30; root cause an unbounded trigger-queue table after a pruning job silently failed since ~Apr 6; events received while disabled are unrecoverable
availability: remediated per vendor; some follow-ups planned
limitation: Self-reported metrics; planned message-queue replacement and review process not verified as delivered

source_title: Sessions add preloaded tools and direct tools preset
claim_summary: Sessions can preload frequently used tools into session.tools() and MCP list and use a direct-tools preset; composio.create() makes a fresh session per call, use() resumes; session.update() added (core 0.9.0 / py 0.13.0)
availability: released SDK versions
limitation: Vendor advises <20 preloaded tools to avoid context bloat; no independent measure of agent accuracy or cost

source_title: New Endpoint: Revoke OAuth 2.0 Tokens for a Connected Account
claim_summary: POST /api/v3.1/connected_accounts/{id}/revoke revokes OAuth 2.0 tokens at the upstream provider; changelog states deleting a connected account or project does not revoke upstream tokens
availability: available; 400 where toolkit does not support revoke
limitation: Revocation depends on provider support; deletion-without-revocation is a documented residual risk

source_title: Python SDK 0.13.1 adds experimental shared connections
claim_summary: Experimental shared connected accounts usable by another user_id only when a per-user ACL permits; list() gains PRIVATE/SHARED/ALL filters
availability: experimental; shape may change
limitation: Experimental API; ACL enforcement not independently tested

source_title: Composio May 2026 security incident update
claim_summary: Vendor discloses unauthorized access to internal systems: foothold in an internal agentic monitoring tool, malicious tool definitions in the execution sandbox, ~0.3% of active connections leaked incl. 5,001 GitHub connections; 5,241 API keys treated as potentially exposed and pre-May-22 keys deleted May 23; internal GitHub token leak noted May 25
availability: incident; page versioned May 21-27 and updated 2026-09-16 with remediation summary
limitation: Vendor states impact beyond listed items unknown; live page has later edits (Sep 16) so May wording relies on archived versions shown on the page; counts not independently audited

source_title: [Security Incident] Composio Connected Accounts
claim_summary: Downstream customer reports being notified of a Composio incident that may have exposed third-party integration credentials; rotated credentials, disabled features, found no indicators of compromise internally and later terminated its Composio integrations
availability: status marked resolved
limitation: Affected-party account not neutral audit; displayed times lack timezone so the UTC day of the first update is uncertain; one customer's decision is not a rate

source_title: The Composio breach: one token, 10,242 doors
claim_summary: Security vendor reconstructs the chain from Composio's disclosure: compromised employee Gmail OAuth token, magic-link access to internal monitoring tool, malicious sandbox tool definitions, auxiliary credential cache; notes Composio has not disclosed what data was accessed
availability: analysis article
limitation: Mostly derived from Composio's own disclosure; author's firm sells OAuth remediation products; article wording alternates between exfiltrated and potentially compromised

source_title: Security, API, and platform updates
claim_summary: Legacy MCP routes require API key or bearer token; IP allowlisting for API keys; scoped API keys rolling out starting with a proxyExecute preset; Proxy Execute becomes opt-in per key and disabled on v3; connected-account tokens redacted for all auth configs; remote workbench runs only inside a session; signed webhook deliveries and loopback targets rejected
availability: mixed: most changes live; scoped keys described as slowly rolling out
limitation: Roll-up note without per-change dates; scoped-key rollout completeness unknown at publication

source_title: TypeScript SDK 0.11.0 moves custom tools to Tool Router
claim_summary: Removes composio.tools.createCustomTool in-memory registry; custom tools move to Tool Router sessions via experimental_createTool/experimental_createToolkit; triggers.create forwards userId for 2FA ownership checks (Python 0.14.0 removed the legacy registry on Jun 16)
availability: pre-1.0 minor release with breaking change
limitation: Replacement API labelled experimental; downstream migration effort unmeasured

source_title: Composio SDK < 0.2.32-beta.283 - Sensitive File Upload via tool-file-uploads.ts (CVE-2026-59807)
claim_summary: CVE-2026-59807: readFileFromDisk in tool-file-uploads.ts lacked assertSafeFileUploadPath so prompt-injected file_uploadable params could make the CLI upload files such as SSH keys; fix PR #3763 merged 2026-07-06 and shipped in prerelease @composio/cli 0.2.32-beta.283
availability: fixed in CLI prerelease 0.2.32-beta.283; issue #3746 opened 2026-07-03
limitation: Severity differs by source (CVSS 3.1 6.8 vs CVSS 4.0 8.9); PR cites GHSA-hp3h-89pf-5q58 which was not found in the global advisory database; no exploitation evidence

source_title: TypeScript SDK 0.14.0 hardens file uploads and tool execution
claim_summary: URL uploads reject private/loopback/link-local/reserved addresses with per-hop redirect checks; error telemetry redacts credentials; tools.execute and proxyExecute no longer retry non-idempotent writes
availability: released SDK version
limitation: Vendor changelog; SSRF protection not independently tested

source_title: Callback identity verification for OAuth connections
claim_summary: Opt-in per-project verifier URL: Composio hands each OAuth return to the customer's server and activates the connection only after the server confirms the signed-in user
availability: opt-in per project
limitation: Opt-in; protection depends on customer verifier implementation

source_title: Python SDK 0.18.2 and TypeScript SDK 0.15.0 tighten JSON Schema types and secret redaction
claim_summary: Changelog states the telemetry redaction rule missed JSON-shaped key/value pairs so serialized bodies like {api_key: ...} were sent verbatim in error telemetry; fixed in py 0.18.2 / core 0.15.0; adds OpenAI v6/v7 support
availability: fix released
limitation: Vendor-disclosed defect; exposure window and recipients of affected telemetry not quantified

source_title: Granular session permissions for scoped API keys
claim_summary: Scoped project API keys separate session management (create/view/configure/delete) from session tool execution (search, execute, proxy execute, session MCP access)
availability: vendor-stated available
limitation: Brief note; no independent permission test

source_title: Two questions every security review asks us
claim_summary: Vendor describes project-scoped hashed API keys, AES-256-GCM envelope-encrypted OAuth tokens with AWS KMS, per-call disposable execution containers, OIDC internal auth, customer-managed key option said to have shipped, zero data retention and SOC 2 Type II attestation
availability: description of current state; no new launch
limitation: Vendor self-description; page shows modified 2026-09-16; SOC 2 report and pen-test results not seen

source_title: Introducing Composio Shared Connections
claim_summary: Admins connect an app account once for the team; teammates use it without seeing passwords or keys; personal connections take priority; admins see usage history and can delete; developer-facing API described as experimental
availability: dashboard feature; developer API experimental
limitation: No GA label; sharing one credential across a team widens blast radius; controls not independently tested

source_title: Scoped API Keys: Tools Read Now Accepts Read-Scoped Keys
claim_summary: Fixes a scope check that wrongly required write-scoped keys to read tools across multiple toolkits; read-scoped keys now accepted; same entry raises auth-config fetch limit to 200 and ships py 0.22.0 / core 0.19.0
availability: fix released
limitation: Over-restrictive bug pushes users toward broader keys; duration of the defect not stated

source_title: Yang: the software factory behind Composio's toolkits
claim_summary: Vendor describes an internal control plane running coding agents (OpenCode in ephemeral sandboxes) that build, fix and extend toolkits from provider docs and production telemetry; bot reviewers first and a human approves every merge; reports >900 fixer PRs merged and 85% of a week's PRs merged without requested changes
availability: internal system; not a product or open source
limitation: Self-reported weekly metrics with no denominator of rejected or reverted work; not independently audited

source_title: Composio Instant: your agents can now pay for their own tools
claim_summary: Agents get a wallet to pay per call for 100+ paid tools (e.g. Apollo, Exa, ZeroBounce) without user provider accounts; provider keys never reach the agent; failed calls not charged; user-connected accounts take priority; SDK exposes per-call charges
availability: enable in dashboard; no beta/GA label stated
limitation: Vendor launch claim; covers providers' core actions only; spending-control efficacy untested

source_title: Composio Instant: your agents can now pay for their own tools (stated plans)
claim_summary: Same post states plans to add providers weekly via a public request board and to support longer jobs such as browser tasks and phone calls
availability: future intention only
limitation: Uncommitted plan with no dates

source_title: Python SDK 0.26.0 and TypeScript SDK 0.23.0 report input requests and stop retrying Session executions
claim_summary: Session executions no longer retried; tools needing user input raise a typed error; session config types now come from the 2.0.0-rc.11 API client and can carry require_approval on toolkits/tools/tags; schema patterns use a linear-time regex engine
availability: released SDK versions with breaking type changes
limitation: require_approval semantics described at type level only in this note; not independently exercised
